# Code Club

> > Code Club is a global nonprofit providing free coding clubs and digital skills education for youth through volunteer-led communities.

Code Club operates a worldwide network of free coding clubs where young people learn programming through hands-on projects in Scratch, Python, web development, and physical computing. The organization partners with local communities, schools, and international organizations to make coding accessible and inclusive for all youth.

## Key Topics

- Scratch
- Python
- HTML/CSS
- Youth education
- Volunteer opportunities
- Community learning
- Physical computing
- Coding education
- Digital skills
- Club setup
- Raspberry Pi
- BBC micro:bit
- Web development
- Project paths
- Global network

## Getting Started with Code Club

- [Free coding clubs for kids | Code Club](https://codeclub.org): Code Club homepage: free global coding clubs for youth education
- [About Code Club](https://codeclub.org/en/about): Code Club mission and organizational values for youth coding education
- [Join a global community learning coding and programming | Code Club](https://codeclub.org/en/join-a-club): Join Code Club communities learning Scratch, Python, HTML/CSS

## Running and Leading Code Clubs

- [Run a Code Club in your community | Code Club](https://codeclub.org/en/run-a-club): Guide to starting and running a Code Club in your community
- [Mentor at a Code Club](https://codeclub.org/mentor): Guide for mentoring youth in Code Club volunteer programs
- [Resources](https://codeclub.org/en/resources): Club planning materials, session resources, certificates, safety guides
- [Training and events](https://codeclub.org/en/events): Code Club training workshops and events for club leaders

## Learning Pathways and Projects
